description: The Rebellion's alliances strain as Entrapta works with Hordak, Shadow Weaver's past resurfaces and the portal project drives Adora and Catra toward a reality-breaking confrontation.

s02e01.description: Horde robots attack the Whispering Woods while Glimmer struggles with command and the princesses try to capture one intact for study.

s02e02.description: Bow and Glimmer head to Dryl after learning Entrapta is alive while Light Hope sends Adora to repair a First Ones installation.

s02e03.description: The squad investigates a supposedly haunted agricultural region that has stopped communicating while Entrapta begins probing Hordak's private laboratory.

s02e04.description: The princesses turn battle planning into an increasingly elaborate role-playing exercise before attacking a Horde fortress commanded by Scorpia.

s02e05.description: Both sides race into the Northern Reach for First Ones technology, with Sea Hawk joining a mission already complicated by strained relationships.

s02e06.description: Shadow Weaver remembers her life as the sorcerer Light Spinner and the choices that transformed her, while Catra faces a deadline from Hordak.

s02e07.description: Adora and Glimmer discover the family life Bow has concealed from them while Catra hunts for the escaped Shadow Weaver.

s02e08.description: Shadow Weaver arrives at Bright Moon demanding Adora's attention while Entrapta pushes Hordak closer to completing the portal project.

s02e09.description: The squad enters the Crimson Waste and places its trust in formidable local leader Huntara while Hordak reveals the existence of Horde Prime.

s02e10.description: Catra thrives in the Crimson Waste as Adora and Huntara explore Mara's ship for the message left by the previous She-Ra.

s02e11.description: Glimmer considers a risky assault on the Fright Zone with Shadow Weaver's help while Adora tries to reach Entrapta before the portal is activated.

s02e12.description: Adora awakens in an altered reality where she never left the Horde and must work out why familiar lives no longer fit together.

s02e13.description: Reality continues collapsing around Etheria, leaving Adora, Bow and Glimmer with little time to undo the portal's effects.
